tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.description: Moves forward in the direction of its arrow.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.description: Seeks viruses within a range of 30.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.description: Strongly attracts viruses within its field.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: On death, gives nearby immune cells +1 health.

regen.name: Regen
regen.description: Gives nearby cells +1 health every 5 seconds.

bank.name: Bank
bank.description: Each survived battle increases its sale value.

resonant_wall.name: Resonant Wall
resonant_wall.description: Gains +1 health when you buy a B-cell.

resonant_buffer.name: Resonant Buffer
resonant_buffer.description: Each B-cell you buy gains +1 health.

turret.name: Turret
turret.description: Fires Bullet Protein at the nearest virus.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Fires straight ahead. Drag its arrow to aim.

cannon.name: Resonant Cannon
cannon.description: Bullet size increases with the number of B-cells.

bullet_wall.name: Bullet Wall
bullet_wall.description: Absorbs one Bullet Protein and fires two bullets.

impact_wall.name: Impact Wall
impact_wall.description: When damaged, fires two bullets from its ends.

tag_dropper.name: Tag Dropper
tag_dropper.description: Moves forward and drops Tag Protein.

zapper.name: Virus Zapper
zapper.description: Holds 2 Electric Charges; conducts through objects.

generator.name: Electric Generator
generator.description: Absorbs 8 Virus Proteins to gain 8 Electric Charges.

bond.name: Bond
bond.description: Physically links the two nearest cells.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard Bond
bodyguard.description: Takes damage on behalf of its connected network.

radar.name: Radar Bond
radar.description: Connects two nearby cells. Adds 20 microns of range to connected cells.

swapper.name: Swapper Bond
swapper.description: Swaps health with its partner at the start of the next shop.

accelerator.name: Accelerator Bond
accelerator.description: Original effect unknown. Provisional ability: speeds up the network.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.description: Explodes on death, damaging and pushing back friends and viruses.

pusher.name: Pusher
pusher.description: Pushes everything nearby once per second.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: Consumes 4 Bullet Proteins to launch a Bomb. Produced cells last for this battle.

mint.name: Mint
mint.description: Consumes Virus Protein to earn Carbs for the next shop. Conversion rate is provisional.

tag_splitter.name: Tag Seeker Splitter
tag_splitter.description: Seeks viruses and Tag Protein. Consumes 3 tags to split in two. Extra copies last for this battle.

tag_drag.name: Tag Drag Dropper
tag_drag.description: Drag in preparation to place a Tag Protein every 15 microns. Holds 15; picking up next round refills it.

greed_wall.name: Greed Wall
greed_wall.description: At battle start gains 2 HP for each leftover Carb. Bonus lasts for this battle only.

survivor_bomb.name: Survivor Bomb
survivor_bomb.description: Death damages nearby viruses AND immune cells and pushes them. Each survived round adds 8 to its radius for this run.

electric_wall.name: Electric Wall
electric_wall.description: Gains Electric Charge when immune cells or viruses touch it.

electromagnet.name: Electromagnet
electromagnet.description: Draws nearby charge when no virus is in reach. Its magnetic field grows with stored charge.

kinetic_generator.name: Kinetic Generator
kinetic_generator.description: Generates 1 Electric Charge per 12 microns moved. Cannot move by itself.

tag_proof.name: Tag-Proof Seeker
tag_proof.description: Seeks viruses. Immune to contact damage from tagged viruses.

seeker_factory.name: Seeker Factory
seeker_factory.description: Consumes 1 Virus Protein and 2 Bullet Proteins to create a Seeker. Friendly shooters try to feed it.

gatling.name: Gatling Gun
gatling.description: Shoots nearby viruses. Each kill reduces its firing interval by 0.25 seconds for this battle.

kinetic_bond.name: Kinetic Bond
kinetic_bond.description: Connected cells gain health as they move. Distance per health point is experimental.

hungry_bomb.name: Hungry Bomb
hungry_bomb.description: Consumes Virus Protein to grow its blast radius during this battle. Damages enemies AND immune cells.
